customization-layers.title: Map the customization layers
customization-layers.description: Customizations live at enterprise, organization, repository and personal layers, and plugins can carry agents and skills to any of them.

surface-support-check.title: Check surface support
surface-support-check.description: Mark each customization as supported, public preview or not supported on each surface, then choose the governance action for that status.

ownership-model.title: Assign an owner to every layer
ownership-model.description: Each scope has its own owner and review path, from enterprise owners to repository maintainers and individual developers.

change-review.title: Review a customization change
change-review.description: A branch edits a customization, a human owner reviews it, and only merged changes reach the default branch before you verify each surface.

agent-release-path.title: Release a custom agent in stages
agent-release-path.description: Draft a profile, test it privately in .github/agents, release it by moving it to agents/, and track each version by commit SHA.

skill-plugin-versioning.title: Version skills and plugins
skill-plugin-versioning.description: Preview a skill, install it at a reviewed tag or SHA, update deliberately because pinned skills are skipped, and keep plugin and marketplace names stable.

distribution-channels.title: Choose a distribution channel
distribution-channels.description: Four channels reach progressively wider audiences, from one person to every member, so pick the narrowest channel that reaches the audience.

managed-plugin-distribution.title: Distribute plugins with the right control
managed-plugin-distribution.description: Plugins move from available to installed to enabled, and personal, repository default or enterprise managed settings decide who controls each step.

instruction-precedence.title: Resolve instruction conflicts
instruction-precedence.description: GitHub.com Chat ranks personal, repository and organization instructions but provides all of them, while Copilot CLI and VS Code combine files without a general order.

agent-name-collisions.title: Predict which agent wins
agent-name-collisions.description: When agent profiles share a filename, the repository agent wins over the organization agent, which wins over the enterprise agent.

stale-customization-review.title: Find stale customizations
stale-customization-review.description: Place each customization by recent signal and recent edit, then send rows with neither to the owner to confirm, update or retire.

retire-and-migrate.title: Retire and migrate a customization
retire-and-migrate.description: Announce a deprecation, provide and verify a replacement, remove the original in a reviewed pull request, then confirm it no longer appears.
